guide.title: How to Keep Water From Freezing Camping
guide.description: Bottles in the tent and upside down, jugs in a closed cooler, filters in the sleeping bag, and hot water ready at sunrise on a below-freezing night.
guide.metaTitle: Keep Water From Freezing When Camping
guide.metaDescription: How to keep water from freezing when camping: bottles upside down and in the tent, jugs in the cooler, filters kept warm, and hot water ready at sunrise.
